result:
Confirmado que `CompactionResult` es exportado como type desde `./compaction/index.js`. Con esto ya tengo todo lo necesario para proponer el arreglo.

```json
{"file": "src/packages/agent/query.ts",
 "edits": [
   {"old": "import {\n  buildPostCompactMessages,\n} from './compaction/index.js'",
    "new": "import {\n  buildPostCompactMessages,\n} from './compaction/index.js'\nimport type { CompactionResult } from './compaction/index.js'"},
   {"old": "    if (compactionResult) {\n      const {\n        preCompactTokenCount,\n        postCompactTokenCount,\n        truePostCompactTokenCount,\n        compactionUsage,\n      } = compactionResult",
    "new": "    if (compactionResult) {\n      const {\n        preCompactTokenCount,\n        postCompactTokenCount,\n        truePostCompactTokenCount,\n        compactionUsage,\n      } = compactionResult as CompactionResult"}
 ],
 "patterns": [
   {"patron": "compactionresult-unknown-stub-in-querydeps",
    "senal_del_verificador": "query\\.ts.*TS2339: Property '(preCompactTokenCount|postCompactTokenCount|truePostCompactTokenCount|compactionUsage)' does not exist on type '\\{\\}'",
    "fix_generico": "`QueryDeps.autocompact` (internal/queryDeps.ts) declara `compactionResult?: unknown` como stub de tipo — el shape real es `CompactionResult` (compaction/compact.ts, re-exportado por compaction/index.ts). Sin tocar queryDeps.ts, en el archivo consumidor se importa `type { CompactionResult } from './compaction/index.js'` y se afirma `compactionResult as CompactionResult` justo donde se desestructura, dentro del `if (compactionResult)` que ya lo narrowa a no-nulo. No es una afirmación que silencie un error real: el mismo valor ya se pasa sin cambios a `buildPostCompactMessages(result: CompactionResult)` unas líneas más abajo.",
    "edits": [0, 1]}
 ],
 "fixes": [

   "src/packages/agent/query.ts(450,9): error TS2339: Property 'truePostCompactTokenCount' does not exist on type '{}'."
 ],
 "skipped": []
}
```
